description: The Central Bureau of Statistics Curaçao publishes the living accommodation results of the 2011 Census as a set of small spreadsheets on its census page. Table LA12 counts the 54,936 occupied living accommodations by type of electricity supply, with 54,219 connected to the grid, 286 with an own generator and 71 with solar or wind energy. Table LA14 gives water supply, with 54,295 on a supply line and 2,021 using a cistern or groundwater well. Other tables cover toilet drainage, cooking fuel, wells on the premises, building material, period built, quality, tenure, bathrooms, cars per household and facilities such as home internet and landline telephones. Coverage is national for the island, and table LA20 splits landline and mobile access by geozone. Format and access: free XLS and XLSX downloads, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: most tables are island totals with no geography; supply questions allow multiple answers; the data are from 2011, and the 2023 geozone tables read cover population, not dwellings. Simulation uses: household reliance on off-grid water and power, and telecom access by geozone. Related records: the 2023 neighbourhood viewer from the same office.
